docs.summary: Removes a specific component from the GameObject.

typeparams.T: The type of component to remove.

docs.summary:
Removes a specific component from the GameObject.

A component the prefab provides is not the instance's to remove while the editor is the thing holding it: nothing records that it went, so the next time the instance is brought back into line with its prefab it would simply reappear. The editor's own remove offers to break the connection first and then comes back here. In play mode and in a player nothing refreshes an instance, so nothing stands in the way there.
docs.returns: Whether it was removed. False means the prefab provides it, which is the one case this refuses, and a caller that needs it gone has to break the link or change the prefab first.
